_note: Trại chăn nuôi (medieval): people inside raise beasts, and each product of the house comes in by itself, with no beast drawn. A product is made `per` units for every `time` seconds of work of one average herdsman at speed 1 (all the people inside add up, the level of the house speeds it by its craftSpeed); `level` is the level of the house that opens it. What is made goes straight to the store of that good (up to its capacity: the house keeps `cap` of each good in a small store of its own).
